title: E2E.Test.Nested.Direct.PAR2.Repaired.Outer.2026.1080p-TESTGRP
description: A stored RAR5 across four 8 MiB volumes with PAR2 at 20% whose only member is a stored 7z, damaged by deleting the tail articles of an interior volume. The outer is repaired without demoting and the child it streams still delivers the payload byte for byte.
